scope: backend/src/routes/attendance.ts GET native date ordering only
scopeAmendment: Parent authorized cursor helper, patients/payments GET cursor pagination, stable date/id ordering, measured patients formatting optimization, then demonstrated attendance native date sort fix and patient-filter query plan measurement.

decision.action: Replace repeated payment filtering with one grouping pass; add exact-timestamp cursor pagination to patient/payment collection GET routes; measure at 1000 and 10000 synthetic patients
decision.reason: Eliminate measured collection formatting cost and let clients load complete collections beyond default 500 safely across equal timestamps or deleted boundary rows
evidence: scale-baseline.json: patients limit5000 median3923.39ms, limit500 median133.66ms at10kpatients
patients.ts filters all returned payments per patient
backend_api_service.dart requests collection maps without pagination
attendance.ts and stays.ts have unbounded filtered collection responses
decision.risk: low: exact localhost, port, database, user and PostgreSQL version assertions before schema/data changes
